stops accepting.

(`vvvv:pppp`, plus the serial when it has one); `writable` is false for devices Foxglove
can't drive yet (API 1.5).

name, and the colour Foxglove last set or saved for it, `#rrggbb` (API 1.5).

conflicts.description:
Apps running now that may put their own colours back on a device (a vendor's lighting
tool), as `<app> on <device>`.

ScreenInfo.description: One of a device's screens (API 1.4, #560), named by what it is for, never by side.

format.description: `1bit`; frames for other formats aren't taken yet.

name.description: What Foxglove calls it: "Info screen", "Art screen", or the board profile's name.

role.description:
`info` (the panel the PC draws; plugins draw here), `art` (where art plays) or `display`
(one the keyboard's firmware draws itself).

rotation.description: Quarter turns clockwise from upright to how it's stored (an art screen on its side: 1).

width.description: As the screen stores its picture.

params.description:
Draws over an info screen (the panel the PC draws) until `ttl_ms` passes (at most 60 000),
then it goes back to what Foxglove draws. `ttl_ms` 0 holds it until the plugin replaces it,
releases it (`screens.panel_release`) or its connection closes (API 1.3), so a steady screen
needs no re-sending (#281). A later override replaces an earlier one. `width` and `height`
are the screen's, from `screens.list` (API 1.4).

bitmap.description: 1 bit per pixel, rows MSB first, padded to whole bytes, 1 = ink; base64.

screen.description:
The info screen to draw on, by its `screens.list` id (API 1.4). Absent: the keyboard's
first info screen, as before 1.4.
